name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.outTupleL_eq
typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (n : Nat) [inst : NeZero.{0} n]
  (hv : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.Valid g) (tabs : List.{0} (List.{0} Nat)),
  (∀ (t : List.{0} Nat), Membership.mem.{0, 0} tabs t → ∀ (v : Nat), Membership.mem.{0, 0} t v → LT.lt.{0} v n) →
    ∀ (a : List.{0} Nat),
      (∀ (v : Nat), Membership.mem.{0, 0} a v → LT.lt.{0} v n) →
        Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.outTupleL g n tabs a)
          (List.map.{0, 0} Fin.val
            (DisequalityDispersion.tupleEval (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.outputs g hv)
              (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.tabInterp (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g) n tabs)
              (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.listAssign (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g) n a)))

source.code:
theorem GInstance.outTupleL_eq (tabs : List (List ℕ)) (htabs : ∀ t ∈ tabs, ∀ v ∈ t, v < n)
    (a : List ℕ) (ha : ∀ v ∈ a, v < n) :
    g.outTupleL n tabs a =
      (tupleEval (g.outputs hv) (tabInterp g.base n tabs) (g.base.listAssign n a)).map Fin.val := by
  have hb := (g.valid_iff.mp hv).2
  unfold GInstance.outTupleL tupleEval GInstance.outputs
  rw [g.base.evalNodesL_eq n (g.baseValid hv) tabs htabs a ha]
  simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_map, Term.eval, List.cons.injEq, List.cons_append,
    List.nil_append]
  refine ⟨(g.base.listAssign_val n a ha (g.base.xv (g.baseValid hv))).symm,
    (g.base.listAssign_val n a ha (g.base.yv (g.baseValid hv))).symm, ?_⟩
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro j hj
  simp only [Function.comp]
  rw [← g.base.evalNodes_getD (g.baseValid hv) _ _ ⟨0, NeZero.pos n⟩ j (hb j hj)]
  exact getD_map_val (NeZero.pos n) _ j
